limits: Unsigned development packages and synthetic/mock workloads only.

CI Windows NSIS fixtures use a disposable profile and force a Restricted process policy; they verify intact install, duplicate rejection, tampered payload rejection, native version execution and uninstall.
Real Rivian/vehicle compatibility and native OS credential-store acceptance were not performed.
Real-certificate signing/notarization, clean-machine acceptance, legitimate vehicle enrollment and independent-provider adversarial review remain open.
The 120-second retained resource benchmark is a separate exact Linux artifact; later delivery fixes do not change its application source.
